profile.headline: Software Engineer at Baxter
profile.summary:
PROJECTS

GIPHY Search Engine
• Created a website with a search engine that will loop through GIPHY’s API and display image results on a custom CSS grid.
• The home page contains a nav-bar that includes a search field where the user can search for the GIF of their choosing.
• Technologies used: HTML/CSS/JavaScript/Jquery/Bootstrap

To-Do List App
• Developed a fully-functional React-based “todo list” web app.
• User is able to create/read/update/delete data for their personal checklist.
• Technologies used: HTML/CSS/JavaScript/React

Stock Trading App
• Created a stock trading app where the user can get quotes for various stocks using the Yahoo Finance API.
• User is able to buy the stock which is then added to their portfolio and can also sell the stock, which will then update their
“wallet” accordingly.
• Technologies used: HTML/CSS/JavaScript/React/Express/Node.js/SQLite

3-Tier Custom Quiz Building App
• Created an app using 3-Tier architecture that lets the user register and login to a forum where users may ask and answer questions.
• User is able to logout and log back in while still being able to view their past work.
• Technologies used: HTML/CSS/JavaScript/React/React-Router/Express/Node.js/SQLite/Passport

positions.title: Physician Recruiter
positions.description:
Develop strong relationships with physicians and client contacts to maintain a consistent pipeline of business. 
Coordinate the screening of candidates by reviewing resumes for potential job matches. Facilitate credentialing and  licensing for physicians prior to any clinical assignments
Responsible for the negotiations of contracts and rates with prospective clients and physicians.
Coordinate travel arrangement for physicians on assignments
Responsible for training new hires on my team

positions.title: Restaurant Manager
positions.description: Hire, train, supervise, and schedule kitchen and service staff. Manage purchasing and inventory control to ensure     sufficient levels of high-quality product.

positions.title: Rooms Controller
positions.description:
February 2013 – June 2015
Cross-Trained Meeting Concierge – Conference Services
Enlisted support services from hotel departments (Engineering, Housekeeping, Banquets, Reservations, F&B, Accounting, Security & Sales) to ensure high experience levels were achieved.
Responsible for the direct supervision and execution of conferences and events encompassing 160,000 square feet of function space
Rooms Controller
Liaison between all hotel departments, including Front Office, Sales, Conference Services, Housekeeping, & Reservations to ensure smooth arrival and departure for all resort guests.
Coordinate check in and pre-registration procedures with Meeting Planners to secure proper hotel rooms for all group arrivals.
Compile guest preferences in order to effectively organize room assignments for an 800 guest room property
November 2012 – February 2013	
Front Office Agent & Concierge
Managed guest check-in / arrival and check out / departure process.
Organized daily spreadsheets of guest accounts, receipts / folios, and vouchers.
Assisted Group Housing and Reservations departments with group bookings and billing.
Arranged both planned and last minute requests for various hospitality services; including transportation, entertainment, activities and dinner reservations.
